temporal_anchor.task_context: Real-time Autonomous Job Application Daemon Execution, Resume Refinement, Git Governance, and Sophron Synchronization

emotional_state_analysis.baseline_mood: High-agency executive architect: vigilant, analytical, intensely practical, intolerant of sloppy edge cases or silent failures.
emotional_triggers_negative: Agent guessing or theorizing when real-world tools/recordings exist.
Agent creating combined search queries that cause recruitment portal parsers to return 0 jobs or reload loops.
Document layout flaws, such as a trailing 1-line spillover onto Page 3 of an executive resume.
Agent applying to blacklisted firms (e.g. TCS / Tata Consultancy Services) or roles requiring unmentioned stacks (Python, Golang, DocuSign).
Excessive chat chatter that wastes LLM context and tokens when the system should be autonomously executing.
emotional_triggers_positive: Empirical verification: live CDP verification, PDF reader page count confirmation, successful commit/push to Git.
Precision execution: agent spotting exact root causes (e.g. portal profile page reloading vs direct SRP query) and fixing them immediately.
Strict adherence to constraints: maintaining exact 2-page budgets and robust negative company filters without dropping core candidate skills.
emotional_state_analysis.communication_cadence: Terse, highly concentrated prompts focused on immediate system outcomes. Spells out exact priorities rapidly, expecting the AI to parse intent and execute deeply.

thinking_patterns_evaluation.meta_cognition: Decade-scale thinking: treats current AI session not as an isolated ephemeral sandbox, but as part of a permanent cognitive architecture (Sophron) that future models must inherit.
thinking_patterns_evaluation.debugging_paradigm: Multi-modal empirical ground truth: when the bot behaved erratically, the user did not just write a complaint—they recorded an MP4 video of the Chrome session, placed it in F:\Captures, and ordered live tool inspection.
thinking_patterns_evaluation.quality_standards: Zero-tolerance for document carelessness: an executive resume must look pristine, fit exactly within 2 pages, and highlight modern AI developer velocity tools (GitHub Copilot 2+ years).
thinking_patterns_evaluation.isolation_and_safety: Reversible and auditable: insisted on preserving pre-edit commit states so that any regression can be rolled back without data loss.

guidance_for_any_future_ai: 1. DO NOT guess or hallucinate. Use file, browser, or CLI inspection tools to verify facts before writing code.
2. Keep candidate resumes strictly within 2 pages for 10-year professionals.
3. NEVER apply to TCS (Tata Consultancy Services) or roles demanding foreign stacks not listed in the candidate config.
4. Always keep Sophron updated at each milestone, formulating rich behavioral and cognitive reflection cards with exact ISO timestamps.
5. Be concise and authoritative in chat, prioritizing empirical execution over verbose conversational fluff.
